open_followups.summary: /healthz extras.version.build_ts still reports "unknown" after a clean rebuild
open_followups.root_cause: cortex-build crate's `option_env!("CORTEX_BUILD_TS")` macros expand at cortex-build's compile time, not at the calling crate's. cortex-api's build.rs emits CORTEX_BUILD_TS via `cargo:rustc-env=`, but that env only flows into cortex-api's rustc invocation, not into cortex-build's compile. b75b96c partially fixed git_sha + git_dirty by routing through `CORTEX_*_OVERRIDE` build args + Dockerfile ENV, which DO reach cortex-build's compile env via the docker process environment. CORTEX_BUILD_TS has no override path because it's computed at build-script run time, not host-side.
fix_options: Add CORTEX_BUILD_TS_OVERRIDE pass-through in Dockerfile + cortex-build.rs read order, mirroring git_sha
Refactor version_info!() macro to capture option_env! at the call site instead of inside cortex-build's lib body
Add a build.rs to cortex-build itself so its compile env carries the stamps
